verdict.rationale: Vercel Agent is a built-in AI assistant available through dashboard chat and Slack. It can investigate issues, review code and take approved actions. The official Vercel MCP server, confirmed live by probe, also lets approved AI clients run deployments, logs, analytics and even domain purchases from natural-language prompts, with a sample prompt documented per tool. missing for 10: built-in chat is public beta and limited to Pro/Enterprise, no independent or hands-on evidence of natural-language operation working end-to-end, MCP route requires an external approved AI client.
